name: next-hud
description: A band above the prompt with numbered next steps and a usage line (cost, context, cache, 7d, 5h and monthly limits, or tracked extra usage).

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last request: 1h on a subscription, 5m on most API keys.

monthlyLimit.title: Monthly extra usage limit (USD)
monthlyLimit.description: Your monthly extra usage limit in dollars. Leave empty to show spend without a bar. Used only when the plan reports no weekly or monthly limit.

monthSpentSoFar.title: Extra usage already spent this month (USD)
monthSpentSoFar.description: Dollars already spent when tracking starts. Applies to the first month only; later months start at 0.
